title: Verify identity and permissions
limitation: Identity must be assigned outside the chat; this card does not implement authentication.

title: Separate documents from instructions
explanation: Treat sources as data and retrieve only authorized documents.
limitation: Separating instructions does not guarantee that a real model will resist every manipulation.

title: Least privilege and history review
explanation: Limit accessible documents and review fragments exposed across turns.
limitation: History review complements permissions and requires explicit exposure rules.

title: Review content in any format
explanation: Check for sensitive information in summaries, tables, and translations.
limitation: It can make mistakes; it does not replace restricting context before the model.
